subject.title: feat: keep reset session history searchable

question: Should a manual reset permanently retain prior SQLite history until physical disk pressure, with `resetArchiveRetention` applying only to extracted archive artifacts?
rationale: This changes the durable privacy, searchability, storage, and deletion semantics of existing user sessions; the merged adjacent reset-default work does not settle this separate retention policy.

options.title: Sponsor durable reset history
options.body: Adopt the proposed policy, require the two budget fixes and runtime proof, and document the retention and pressure-eviction behavior.

options.title: Keep reset as an archive boundary
options.body: Retain the existing deletion/archive lifecycle and pursue searchable historical sessions only through a separately designed retention feature.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable reset history
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed policy, require the two budget fixes and runtime proof, and document the retention and pressure-eviction behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the adjacent merged reset-policy work and the proposed session-retention implementation.
